changes.removed.expectation: removed rows are counted; `since` after `snapshot` refused

check-apart.protected.expectation: a lake inside a protected location is refused

close-clickhouse.harmless.expectation: closing what is not held changes nothing

close-read.idempotent.expectation: one key lets a read go once

commit.guarded.expectation: a view is refused; a forged transaction is refused

commit.idempotent.expectation: one key commits once and answers the same

connect-clickhouse.guarded.expectation: plain HTTP to another machine and a missing secret are refused

current-snapshot.after-commit.expectation: the snapshot a commit made is current

current-snapshot.forged-handle.expectation: a forged lake handle is refused

describe-source.landed-types.expectation: a source's columns as they land; an unknown source refused

describe.binder-only.expectation: a SELECT's columns from the binder; anything else refused

execute.guarded.expectation: ATTACH, COPY TO and SET are refused in a transaction

existing-latest.reads.expectation: latest, verify, committed-at, columns, views and a read, exact

held.lists-open.expectation: what is held is listed; a closed lake is let go and refused

is-object-storage.schemes.expectation: s3://, gs:// and az:// only, case as written

json-frame.columns.expectation: the columns with their DuckDB types and the closing tail; no type is refused

json-rows.exact.expectation: exact text, NULL as null, rows separated

load-arrow.exact.expectation: a DECIMAL and a NULL are loaded exactly

location-components.parts.expectation: object storage and local paths by parts; anything else refused

locations-overlap.prefix.expectation: inside overlaps, a sibling with the same prefix does not

maintain.idempotent.expectation: one key maintains once and answers the same

maintain.naive-cutoff.expectation: a cutoff without a zone is refused

open-existing-lake.guarded.expectation: encryption and a missing protected set are refused

open-lake.limits-required.expectation: a lake without every limit is refused (law 7)

open-lake.source-not-found.expectation: a missing source file is refused before anything opens

read-batch.ends.expectation: every row once, then None; a forged read is refused

rollback.discards.expectation: a rolled-back transaction writes nothing and is let go

snapshot.kept-or-none.expectation: a kept snapshot is found; an unknown or negative id is None

start-read.exact.expectation: DECIMAL, HUGEINT, TIMESTAMPTZ and NULL are read exactly

start-read.guarded.expectation: file readers, writes, two statements and unknown snapshots are refused

start-read.parameters.expectation: a parameter is bound by name with its type

statistics.counts.expectation: every row is counted; an unknown table refused

table-columns.as-of.expectation: the columns as of the snapshot asked

value.first-cell.expectation: the first cell as text; None when there is no row

clickhouse_estimate.returns: tuple[dict[str, str | int | float | bool | None], ...]
